name: Himitsu
source:
Main character is a temporary lecturer who picks up girl's notebook and photo at school. When he tries to return them to the girl, she asks his cooperation to avenge bully girls in class in exchange for her body... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名临时讲师，他在学校捡到了女孩的笔记本和照片。当他试图把它们还给女孩时，女孩请求他配合，为班上欺负女孩的人报仇，以换取她的身体…… 

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
